items.title: Rick Montalbano interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 12, 2011
items.q: John Jaski at the time, my accordion teacher, he had a band and he would double book himself, and then he would send me out on a gig

ctx.x: That was a lot. Yeah. I was knocked out by that. They didn’t all pay that, and some of those things I did early on they passed the hats, they were little things at the Moose Club and those kinds of things. Always with the older musicians, I was always the kid. And John Jaski at the time, my accordion teacher, he had a band and he would double book himself, and then he would send me out on a gig, with his amp, you know he’d give me an amp and I’d bring the accordion and I’d play with a couple of guys somewhere.…
sometime during the night he would leave one place and he’d just go show up at the other place, just like “hi folks, here I am.”
